New: dictation. Hold Fn anywhere, speak, let go, and the text is typed where your cursor is.

What's new

- Dictation: hold Fn (or Right Option / Right Command, set in Setup) in any app and speak. A pill under the notch shows a waveform and your words as you say them; words that may still change are dimmer. Let go and the text is typed into the focused field. Double-tap the key for hands-free, tap it again to stop; Esc cancels.
- Speech-to-text runs on this Mac with Apple's on-device speech engine. No audio leaves the Mac, and nothing is saved.
- Clean-up: filler words and spoken punctuation ("comma", "new line") are handled by built-in rules. With your own Anthropic API key saved in Setup, Claude Haiku also fixes grammar and punctuation before the text is pasted; the key is kept in the macOS Keychain only. If Claude is slow or fails, the rule-cleaned text is pasted instead.
- Type as I speak (off by default): each phrase is typed into the field as soon as you pause, without touching the clipboard. Claude clean-up is skipped in this mode. If you switch apps mid-sentence, typing stops and the rest goes to the clipboard.
- Password fields are never typed into.

Limits

- Dictation needs macOS 26. On macOS 15 the rest of the app works as before.
- The first use of a language may download Apple's speech model for it.
- Without Accessibility access the text is copied to the clipboard instead of typed.

Install or upgrade:

    brew install --cask ankeshshankar/tap/ai-notch
    brew upgrade --cask ai-notch

After upgrading, open Setup → Dictation, switch it on and allow Microphone, Input Monitoring and Accessibility. The app is signed ad hoc, so macOS forgets these three permissions after each upgrade: remove AI Notch from each list in System Settings → Privacy & Security, add it again, then quit and reopen the app.

First open: the app is signed ad hoc and not notarized, so macOS blocks it once. Open AI Notch, then in System Settings → Privacy & Security click Open Anyway and confirm with your password. If Set Up then reports the helper is blocked, run the command it shows:

    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/AINotch.app

Requires macOS 15 or later (dictation: macOS 26).
